chargeCoverageAndOverflow.adoptedRule: Both adopted branches carry actual charge(s) supported by the participant record and selected instrument; unclear/mixed/unsupported records stop for clarification/manual review.

dismissalBranch.treatment: Do not silently drop extra charges. Until a supported overflow representation is defined for this branch, hold such records rather than adding a universal component.

diversionDeferredBranch.existingSupportedOverflow: Existing required wv_nc_diversion_deferred-supplemental-pleading-2 remains and its worklist says all same-transaction/occurrence charges go in one motion.

chargeCoverageAndOverflow.acquittalBranch: The adopted separate §61-11-25 civil petition must carry actual charge(s); its exact multi-charge layout remains an implementation acceptance item, not an owner question.

branchFixtureHandoff.requirement: Later builder freezes and raster-queues dismissal and acquittal branches independently, each with canonical and boundary fixtures; one assembled sample cannot stand in for both.
branchFixtureHandoff.existingConvention: Existing RCAP families use canonical.pdf and boundary.pdf (or branch-named equivalents) with matching raster/canonical and raster/boundary outputs. Apply that convention separately to each branch.
